Subject: New stage tags + 30-min sandbox training (Commit/Best Case/Pipeline)

Team —

Quick update and a small ask before this week closes. Finance and RevOps approved the revised definitions for Commit / Best Case / Pipeline. The changes are narrowly targeted (see attached one-pager) but they affect how we mark deals that are pending SOWs, legal review, or require customer procurement sign-off. The two big clarifications:

- Commit now requires "signed contract OR PO with confirmed billing start date" (no longer just verbal agreement).
- Best Case should be reserved for deals with an identified budget and an internal exec champion, but without a signed/committable purchasing instrument.

I'm running a 30-minute sandbox training this Wednesday at 10:00am PT to walk through examples in HubSpot and a short checklist you can paste into your deal notes. Agenda: 5m overview, 15m HubSpot tagging walkthrough, 10m Q&A + quick practice.

Action items:
- Everyone: please scan your commits and best cases and apply the new tags by EOD Friday (I assigned a saved view called "StageTagging - Aug26" in HubSpot).
- Marissa: can you surface any deals with outstanding legal language that might still be mis-tagged?
- Karthik: please review the ACME Expansion (deal ACME-2026-Expansion-42) — Jordan asked whether our previous classification still holds after their procurement note.

Attachments: forecast_stage_cheatsheet.pdf (1-page rules), stage-tagging-training-slides.pptx

If you can't make Wed 10am PT, recording + sandbox link will be uploaded to the Drive link below.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

Quick question on ACME: Jordan replied to our thread and said they submitted a PO to their Procurement team but procurement hasn't issued a PO number yet. Does that scenario qualify as Commit per the new wording ("PO with confirmed billing start date")? My read: until Procurement issues a PO number OR the contract is signed we should tag it as Best Case. Jordan is pushing for Commit since procurement sign-off is "in progress".

I'll join Wed if only to show this exact example — seems like a good training case.

Karthik

Thanks for the quick clarifications —

Karthik: correct interpretation. "In progress" procurement without an issued PO number OR a signed contract is Best Case. Please keep the deal as Best Case until Jordan can confirm the PO number or we receive an executed SOW.

Jordan: appreciate the update — once procurement has a PO number please reply-all with the PO number and billing start date and we will move ACME-2026-Expansion-42 to Commit immediately. If Procurement can't provide a PO number but the legal team can sign the SOW this week, that also qualifies.

Marissa: if you see other deals stuck because of procurement processes, file them under the Ops queue (tag: "procurement-blocked") so RevOps can batch escalation.

I'll upload the recording and a short checklist to the Drive now: https://drive.example/redwood/stage-tagging-recording

Best —
